Asset type: one production square transparent 3 by 3 equal-cell monster MATERIAL icon sprite atlas, 1024x1024, for a vintage fantasy cartography browser game.

Clear distinct silhouettes readable at 32-40px on parchment. Flat illustrated objects, pale ivory, umber, muted sage, slate, dark rusty red. (2) Sacred Feathers — three pale ivory and muted grey feathers tied at their ends with a small plain string. (3) Nightmare Chitin — two irregular blue-grey and umber raw crab shell shards with ridges and one short spine, NOT a finished armour breastplate.
ROW THREE: (1) Troll Ash — a shallow small clay bowl holding a mound of pale grey ash with one faint dusty wisp. (2) EMPTY transparent. (3) EMPTY transparent.
Constraints: genuine alpha transparency surrounding objects and in empty cells. No parchment background, checkerboard, text, letters, labels, numbers, watermark, coins, UI, buttons, people, monsters or decorative frame. Seven icons only in this exact grid.
